subject: Re: Zenora pilot — reactivate lapsed credits and request extension
messages:
From: Alex Green <alex.green@zenora.ai>
To: evelyn_hart@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-11-28T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Zenora pilot expired — request to reactivate and extend credits

Hi Evelyn / Marissa,

Thanks for the pilot support so far. We noticed our sandbox credits expired last week and the engineers on our side hit a hard stop during a demo run. We still have active interest from two teams and would like to keep momentum.

Could Redwood restart our sandbox and add a 30% extension on top of the remaining pilot allocation so the teams have time to complete a set of integration tests and an exec demo? I attached a short usage extract so you can see the burst pattern.

Attachments: zenora_usage_report_q3.csv (csv)

Next steps from our side: procurement is ready to sign a small charge if needed. If a short-term credit restart + extension is possible, please let me know what you need from procurement.

Appreciate speedy help — demo is Wednesday PST.

—Alex
Alex Green
Head of ML Integrations, Zenora
alex.green@zenora.ai
From: evelyn_hart@redwood.ai
To: Alex Green <alex.green@zenora.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-11-28T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Zenora pilot expired — request to reactivate and extend credits

Alex — thanks for the context and the usage extract.

We can absolutely help prevent the demo from slipping. Two quick items:

1) Immediate triage: I can request a sandbox restart for Zenora today — that gets your engineers back online within an hour.
2) Credit extension: for pilot accounts we handle a case-by-case makegood. To unblock the Wednesday demo I can provision a temporary 30% top-up pending a quick approval from finance. Ben is cc'd to confirm the one-off.

Marissa, can you share the short internal approval note (amount and expiration) so I can route it to Ben for sign-off? Alex, if procurement is willing to accept a one-off charge in short order, include the procurement contact or signature email and we can issue an invoice.

If you prefer, I can do a 48-hour extension first and add the 30% upon approval — whichever is faster for your demo.

Thanks,
Evelyn Hart
Senior Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
evelyn_hart@redwood.ai
(415) 555-0192
From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: evelyn_hart@redwood.ai, Alex Green <alex.green@zenora.ai>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-11-29T09:30:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Zenora pilot expired — request to reactivate and extend credits

Evelyn / Alex — looping in the proposed approval note for Ben.

Proposed one-off credit allocation: $1,500 equivalent (30% top-up on original $5k pilot), expires 2028-01-15. Will be recorded as makegood/marketing pilot concession; no change to current contract terms. If procurement prefers to convert to a paid monthly trial, we can provide a simple PO/invoice instead.

Why we recommend this: Zenora showed steady bursty usage centered on short evaluation runs. Restarting with a 30% buffer preserves demo fidelity and gives the team time to convert.

Next actions:
- Ben: confirm approval to issue credit note and the exact accounting tag.
- Alex: confirm procurement email for invoicing if you want a paid top-up.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

Thanks — approved. Finance will issue a credit note for $1,500 and a temporary restart of the sandbox today. Credit note id: CN-2027-1129-ZEN452. Attached is the PDF for your records.

- Sandbox restarted for zenora-prod-sandbox (token TTL 72 hours, will extend if we receive a signed acceptance).
- Credit note issued and uploaded to the deal record.
- Invoice option: Alex, if procurement sends a PO, we can convert the credit to a short paid trial — please send purchasing contact.
